::: {.lead}
<center>**Decoding Life through Data**</center>
Big Bioinformatics Lab (BigBio Lab) is an independent bioinformatics research and training center based in Bangladesh. Our goal is to address critical health challenges through modern multi-omics data analysis and capacity building in bioinformatics.
:::
